tools.name: research__conduct-deep-research
tools.description: Conduct deep, iterative research on a topic by generating multiple search queries, processing the results, and recursively exploring new research directions.

topic.description: The main topic or question to research

objective.description: The specific goal or objective of the research

breadth.description: Number of search queries per research direction (1-5)

max_total_queries.description: Maximum number of search queries to process (2-5)

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum duration for the research process in seconds (60-300)

connection_id.description: Optional connection ID for the user

tools.name: research__generate-research-report
tools.description: Generate a comprehensive research report from existing research data.

research_data.description: The research data and findings to include in the report

objective.description: The specific goal or objective of the report

tools.name: search__converse
tools.description: Reply conversationally when the request is ambiguous or needs clarification.

reply_hint.description: Optional hint for the conversational reply.

tools.name: search__search
tools.description: Run live Google search and summarize results.
